entries.desc: The baseline sha is captured AFTER autoSyncMain, so Lattice own pre-check sync does not false-positive the abort.

entries.desc: The abort throw releases the main-write-lock via the existing try/finally, so subsequent DONEs are not deadlocked.

The smoke additionally asserts the aborted story is recoverable (worktree + branch survive).
